Number formats are the fastest filter across all six documents. Each office publishes a rule, and a document that breaks its own rule is wrong no matter how good the print looks.

Ask the register question for whichever document you are buying. A seller who can answer it for a passport usually can for a licence too, and a seller who cannot answer it for either is a reseller.

Substrate differs by document, which is why a single feel test does not work across a set. Polycarbonate cards flex and spring back. Passport pages are dense and cool. Paper laminated between sheets clicks when tapped.

The Australian passport comes from the relevant issuing office. The licence comes from a different office entirely, and the identity card from a third. A seller who talks about all three in one breath is describing a shopping list, not a supply chain.

Replica versus registered original applies to every Australian document and it is the distinction that sets the price. A replica copies the look. A registered original carries a number in an office record and resolves when checked.

What to check in Australia

Two local checks and the generic tells, whichever document you are buying.

  • Confirm the state crest and the state licence number pattern, which differs in every state and territory.
  • Check the passport for the kangaroo and emu watermark and the intaglio printing on the data page.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the relevant issuing office. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags

  • A card that lists an address in a state other than the one in the header.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

What should a passport cost on Telegram?

Between 180 and 900 US dollars depending on whether you are buying a print, correct stock, or a number that resolves at the issuing office.

Is a Telegram passport genuine?

Usually not. Most adverts sell a replica or a registered original, and the two are priced very differently. Ask which one it is in writing.

How long does delivery take?

Adverts quote anything from same day to four weeks. A tracked number that moves inside 48 hours is the realistic standard.

Can a passport number be checked?

Only against the issuing office register or an airline check-in system. A seller who offers no route to a register check is selling a print.

What is the most common fake?

A colour photocopy of a real data page laminated into a blank cover with a plausible number typed in.

Choose a document

Run the six checks on the page you need before you discuss the others. Once one document passes properly, the seller has shown you their standard and you can judge the rest against it.
